guidetextdraw._value:
Instructions - 

  • To change the meeting pattern, you must cancel the existing class and add a new class with a new section number.
  • To change the session, you must cancel the existing class and add a new class with a new section number.
  • To change the section number, you must cancel the existing class and add a new class with a new section number.

Access to “Schedule Class Meetings” and “Update Sections of a Class” is open in PeopleSoft to make immediate changes for the following fields without having to submit an approval form.

Go to: Curriculum Management >> Schedule of Classes >> Schedule Class Meetings

  • Instructor changes (Fall/Spring state-support classes only)

Go to: Curriculum Management >> Schedule of Classes >> Update Sections of a Class

  • Change Enrollment Caps (Do not set higher than the Room Cap)
  • Change Waitlist Caps (Do not set waitlist caps for courses with corequisites)
  • Class Status Changes (i.e. Tentative to Active, Active to Tentative, or Active to Stop Further Enrollment)
  • Schedule Print/No Print
  • Department Consent
